title: 1 Baht - Rama IX (Non-magnetic)

obverse.description: Bust of King Bhumibol Adulyadej, or Rama IX, facing left.
obverse.lettering:
ภูมิพลอดุลยเดช 
รัชกาลที่ ๙

reverse.description: Wat Phra Kaew Temple, Bangkok and the denomination to the right.
reverse.lettering:
ประเทศไทย 
พ.ศ. ๒๕๔๒
๑
1 บาท

comments:
This coin was monetized on August 8th, 1986, and the first issue coins in 2529 (1986) have the short roof decorations on building on the right but was corrected in the same year meaning coins from the year 2529 (1986) with normal (long) roof decorations are the rare version.

2529


2534

2549


Made-to-order coins exist:
- Coins struck on copper planchet; PCGS #35515203 (3.7g), PCGS #36821775 (3.85g), PCGS #37982044. Non-graded coins also exist (3.78g and 3.92g)
- Coins struck on silver planchet; NGC #3947512-065 (5g), PCGS #36821776 (4.9g), PCGS #37982041.
- Coin struck on 8.6 grams gold planchet; PCGS #36837182.
// MTO set 2542 is consist of coins from 1 Satang to 5 Baht, with each type struck on copper, silver, and gold. 16~18 sets are believed to be made. (source by siamcoin)
- Coin struck as uniface obverse on silver planchet.
- Coin dated 2542 (1999), struck as uniface reverse on silver planchet.
- Coin dated 2543 (2000), struck as uniface reverse on silver planchet.
// MTO silver uniface sets. (source by siamcoin)
- Coin struck as uniface obverse on brass planchet.
- Coin dated 2546, struck as uniface reverse on brass planchet.
// MTO brass uniface sets. (source by siamcoin)
- Coin struck as uniface obverse; PCGS #80704782. (pair of uniface 2543)
- Coin struck as uniface reverse, dated 2543; PCGS #80704781. (pair of uniface 2543)
- Coin struck as uniface obverse; NGC #4623205-005, PCGS #37982054. (pair of uniface 2544)
- Coin struck as uniface reverse, dated 2544; NGC #4623205-006, PCGS #37982055. (pair of uniface 2544)
- Coin struck as double obverse, medal alignment; PCGS #37982048, NGC graded coin also exists.
- Coin dated 2537, struck as double reverse, medal alignment; PCGS #37982049.
- Coin dated 2532 struck as medal alignment; PCGS #80717157. (set of medal alignment 25 Satang to 5 Baht 2532)
- Coin dated 2542 struck as medal alignment; NGC #4536282-096. (could be error)
- Coin struck on 2.39g planchet (likely 50 Satang planchet) exists. 2532 struck on 50 Satang planchet exist. (likely error)
